name: One 97 Communications Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2000, One 97 Communications Ltd is India's leading digital ecosystem for consumers as well as merchants. As of March 31, 2021, the company has a 333 million+ client base and 21 million+ registered merchants to whom it offers payment services, financial services, and commerce and cloud services.[1]
keyPoints: Business Overview:[1] The company operates Paytm, a payment-led consumer and merchant ecosystem. Payments acquire and engage users and merchants. The same base is monetised through device subscriptions, payment processing, loan distribution, equity broking, mutual funds, insurance, advertising, travel and other marketing services. Lending remains capital-light. Loans are underwritten and booked by lending partners, while Paytm provides distribution, customer insights, the borrower interface and collections infrastructure. The merchant acceptance stack includes QR, Soundbox, All-in-One POS and online payment gateway, covering UPI, cards, credit card on UPI and EMI. The consumer app covers UPI P2P and P2M, recharges, bill payments and money transfers.[1][2]
pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 19.4% CAGR over last 5 years
Company's median sales growth is 22.3% of last 10 years
cons: Stock is trading at 6.69 times its book value
Company has a low return on equity of -4.60% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.771 Cr.
